label: Tier 1 changes in verification
subgoals: Identify whether the request changes a value, a selection or a waiver
Apply it through the deck or the run configuration
Rerun the checks without rebuilding the engine

label: Tier 2 plug-ins
subgoals: Find the extension point the request fits: check, extractor, property or output
Implement it against the engine's stable API
Verify it with golden tests on reference layouts

label: Tier 3 core edits
subgoals: Decide whether the change alters a correctness invariant of the kernel
Require a reviewed diff and full regression for core edits
Add a seam when similar requests keep reaching the core
